He helps teach an elective course on Venture Capital and Private Equity in which over 800 students have enrolled since the course was revamped in 2020. He also serves as a Section Chair. Jo helped teach "The Entrepreneurial Manager" (TEM) , a required class for all 900 first-year students and of which he was co-course head for three years.
